summary: Resubmitted the gap answers as a question-level explanation, since the two gaps span separate experiment lineages: one belongs to the lease experiment and the other to the end-to-end experiment, so no single experiment-bound interpretation could carry both. This record omits the experiment id, states the conclusion as explained with the defect claim still asserted, and cites executions from both lineages, the lease receipt and the end-to-end repeat. The added paragraph makes the quorum arithmetic explicit across all the receipts the account uses: with three voters the quorum is two, the leader supplies one vote through the self-vote now recorded in the knowledge entry, and a single non-voter acknowledgement completes the verification, which explains the five-member triggers, the first success under both a 500 ms and a 1 s lease with failures at 510 ms and 1018 ms, and the end-to-end first success at 0 ms well before the successor commits at about 2.4 seconds. Both gaps are answered as resolved, the first noting that the affected uses rely only on a verification succeeding with one of three voters reachable, and the second noting that the end-to-end receipts observed the same first success and a later refusal after step-down without depending on how the two votes were supplied. The full counterevidence and limitation lists are carried over unchanged.
